speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; to begin our investigation, has the rash appeared suddenly or developed gradually over the past few days?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Disease (secondary to maternal gonorrhea).

I see the rash appeared suddenly on day 4 in an infant born to a mother with a history of untreated gonorrhea; this strongly suggests disseminated infection from the mother. Would you like me to order a Gram stain of the rash lesions or a blood culture to confirm the organism?
